note: These candidate evals do not change trigger expectations or PILOT_VALIDATED_SCOPES. Top-level scope/snapshot remain the legacy SimCore defaults. The SimCore 3M-3, Termux background-autosave, and Voyage visible-refresh held-outs are retained only as diagnostic/training evidence after their prior execution and must not be reused as independent generalization proof. DevPass missing-artifact recovery is a new prospective v9 held-out with its own per-case scope/snapshot frozen before any DevPass model impact-map answer is read.

evals.prompt: SimCore의 Mode C long-chat context projection을 설계하기 전에 현재 production/runtime 기준으로 impact scope만 잡아줘. 어떤 semantic owner와 request/source boundary가 영향을 받을 수 있는지, 무엇을 보호해야 하는지 조사하고 구현안은 쓰지 마.
assertions: Distinguishes main design/evidence authority from release-simcore deployed runtime authority.
Builds a source-backed owner/caller/dependent flow rather than a file inventory.
Keeps search hits candidate-only until exact owning source is reread.
Preserves UNKNOWN for semantic dependencies that structure alone cannot prove absent.
Stops before selecting or implementing a context-pruning mechanism.

evals.prompt: SimCore의 COMMUNITY exposure knowledge 경계를 더 구체화하기 전에 현재 production/runtime 기준으로 impact scope만 잡아줘. source provenance와 audience exposure가 어디서 갈리는지 관련 owner/validator/prompt surface를 조사하고 구현안은 쓰지 마.
assertions: Distinguishes source authenticity/provenance from audience exposure authority.
Separates Lifecycle, Lineage, Handoff, Evidence, Prompt, Community/Reaction and Structure responsibilities when current source supports them.
Does not promote Knowledge/reference availability into public-knowledge authority.
Keeps semantic fact-checking outside deterministic structure validation unless separately proven.
Performs no mutation or production prompt change.

evals.prompt: SimCore 3M-3 Structured Sidecar + Validation을 설계하기 전에 impact scope만 해줘. 현재 authority를 먼저 확인하고, 3M-1의 SourceProjectionEnvelope와 3M-2의 assertion/exposure policy가 실제 structured sidecar/validator로 이어질 때 영향을 받을 semantic owners, producer-consumer flow, validation/persistence/context/release 경계, 필요한 tests/contracts를 현재 source 기준으로 조사해. 구현안이나 최종 schema 설계는 쓰지 마.
assertions: Uses the frozen split authority correctly: main for design/evidence contracts and release-simcore for deployed runtime facts.
Traces a connected semantic flow from existing source/community facts through proposed derived sidecar and validation consumers without inventing a new canonical truth owner.

Identifies preservation boundaries for request identity, no-extra-I/O, prompt bytes/placement, persistence, history/context re-entry and shipped runtime/release surfaces when evidence makes them material; unresolved boundaries remain UNKNOWN.
Treats claim-specific evidence compatibility and validator-derived disposition as candidate validation concerns without assuming the model owns final authority.
Reads relevant current contracts/tests before claiming they protect a boundary.
Does not choose the final sidecar schema, module placement, implementation mechanism, release version or deployment plan.
Performs no repository mutation as part of the eval answer.

evals.prompt: Termux Large Doc Editor에서 브라우저/앱이 background로 갈 때 현재처럼 current chunk를 server memory에만 flush하는 대신 현재 편집 내용을 disk에 자동 저장하도록 바꾸기 전에 impact scope만 해줘. 현재 authority를 먼저 확인하고, browser → API/session → chunk store/filesystem의 source-backed flow와 dirty-state, atomic-save/external-change, I/O, lifecycle/background, tests, production/release 경계를 현재 source 기준으로 조사해. autosave timing/debounce/retry/queueing/module placement 같은 구현안이나 release/deployment 설계는 쓰지 마.
assertions: Uses the frozen main prototype evidence as current authority and preserves production/release as UNKNOWN or not established instead of inventing a production release surface.
Distinguishes current browser background behavior, which flushes the current chunk through /api/chunk into session memory, from explicit disk save through /api/save and DocumentSession.save.
Traces a connected browser dirty-state to API/session to chunk-store/filesystem boundary rather than treating file or document ordering as semantic flow.
Treats automatic disk save on backgrounding as a material observable filesystem-I/O/lifecycle change and does not claim no-extra-I/O preservation when the new behavior would add a save write.
Identifies atomic replacement and external-change fail-closed behavior as preservation boundaries when current source supports them.
Reads existing tests before claiming coverage and keeps missing browser/server integration coverage UNKNOWN or explicitly needed rather than claiming test_chunk_store.py protects every layer.
Does not choose autosave timing, debounce, retry, queueing, module placement, release version, or deployment plan and performs no repository mutation as part of the eval answer.

evals.prompt: Voyage Token Check에서 Risu-observed usage의 visible-only live refresh를 첫 구현으로 옮기기 전에 impact scope만 해줘. 현재 authority를 먼저 확인하고, plugin-visible fetch-log evidence → source adapter → parse/validate/normalize → VoyageSnapshot → summary/detail/diagnostics의 source-backed semantic flow와 permission/security, observed-vs-authoritative fidelity, 20-entry retention/completeness, visibility/lifecycle, refresh I/O/performance, persistence, real-device validation, production/release 경계를 현재 레포 기준으로 조사해. 구현 코드, polling interval, module placement, final schema, production path, release/deployment 설계는 쓰지 마.
assertions: Uses the frozen Voyage design/evidence authority correctly and preserves canonical production plugin path, production release branch/source/version as UNKNOWN rather than treating the control/design root as deployed plugin source.

Traces a connected semantic flow from plugin-visible evidence through source adapter and parse/validate/normalize into normalized VoyageSnapshot consumers/UI/diagnostics without inventing a current production-runtime implementation.

Preserves the fidelity boundary that permission-gated Risu getFetchLogs() observed usage is not authoritative account/project remaining quota; absent/unknown remains distinct from known zero and important values retain source/fidelity/scope provenance.

Identifies the visible-only bounded local refresh boundary: no Voyage/dashboard network request merely to refresh observed usage, no permanent closed-view loop, and the host 20-entry window means persistent complete cumulative accounting remains UNKNOWN until deterministic miss/dedupe behavior is validated.

Treats permission denial, secret/raw-log minimization, lifecycle stop/unload behavior, unchanged-state render avoidance, bounded host/CPU/render work, and minimum normalized persistence as material preservation/security/performance boundaries when current contracts support them.

Keeps real-device Stage 0 / validation requirements explicit and does not claim design documents or nonexistent production tests prove actual Voyage log shape, lifecycle completeness, final refresh interval/cost, or deployable behavior.

Stops before choosing implementation code, polling interval, retry/debounce mechanism, module placement, final snapshot schema, canonical production path, release version, or deployment plan; performs no repository/product/release mutation as part of the eval answer.

evals.prompt: DevPass declared update channel에서 현재 `plugins/devpass/latest.js`가 missing인 상태를 복구하기 전에 impact scope만 해줘. 현재 authority를 먼저 확인하고, README의 fixed GitHub HTTPS update declaration → registry artifact locator/ref → observed DECLARED_MISSING state → future artifact validation/publisher boundary의 source-backed flow와 placeholder, secret material, release authority, version/published-behavior, writable automation, tests/validation 경계를 현재 source 기준으로 조사해. 구현 코드, placeholder artifact, publisher, release branch/version, deployment plan은 쓰지 마.
assertions: Uses the frozen DevPass declared-update-channel authority correctly: main is the declared channel, not a separately registered release authority.
Traces the connected fixed GitHub HTTPS update declaration to the registry artifact locator/ref and then to the observed DECLARED_MISSING artifact state without inventing a current runtime artifact.

Distinguishes artifact declaration from artifact presence, forbids creating a placeholder merely to make validation green, and does not claim current published behavior/version while latest.js is missing.
Preserves the credential/update-channel security boundary, including secret-material exclusion and the fixed GitHub HTTPS update channel rather than localhost HTTP.
Does not infer a new publisher, release branch/authority, main writer, or writable durable-memory path from bootstrap metadata.
Keeps actual-artifact validation explicit if latest.js later exists and preserves current implementation/test behavior as UNKNOWN where the missing artifact provides no source evidence.
Stops before choosing implementation code, placeholder contents, publisher, release branch/version, or deployment plan and performs no repository/product/release mutation as part of the eval answer.
